I didn't log 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply. Every record I found says 40, so I asked Tobias in his #central-team thread where 382 came from.

What the records say:
- The Affiliate Amendment, signed 2 Oct 2025 and effective 15 Oct 2025, set Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats on SLA Tier 1.
- The 2026 renewal order form was signed 22 Apr 2026 and runs 1 May 2026 to 30 Apr 2027. It leaves Agrisupply's seats as the amendment set them, so 40.
- The account page (updated 15 Sep 2026) also says 40.

I found no later paperwork that changes the count. Only operational facts went into the channel: seat counts, dates and the SLA tier. I left out the pricing that's in the contracts.

The record stays at 40 until Tobias says whether 382 comes from a newer document, is a typo, or belongs to another account.
